---
description: "Apply the ShareNotes capstone PR requirements when editing or preparing the pull request template."
applyTo: ".github/pull_request_template.md"
---
The PR description must include:

- A 2-3 sentence summary of what was built and why.
- A Changes Made list naming each changed file and the reason for the change.
- Test Evidence with exact command output or CI links; explicitly identify checks that were not run.
- Known Limitations, including Not Found and out-of-scope items.
- A reviewer checklist whose boxes remain unchecked until the reviewer completes them.

Also retain security/data considerations and a changelog section. Never claim a check passed without recorded evidence.
